bib.title: Ragas: Automated Evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation

question: How can RAG pipelines be evaluated automatically without ground-truth reference answers?
hypothesis: LLM-prompted reference-free metrics for faithfulness, answer relevance and context relevance align with human judgements better than direct LLM scoring or ranking.
contributions: Ragas, a suite of reference-free RAG metrics (faithfulness, answer relevance, context relevance)
WikiEval, a dataset with human judgements of the three aspects

method.summary: Three metrics computed by prompting gpt-3.5-turbo-16k (plus ada-002 embeddings for answer relevance). Validated on WikiEval by pairwise agreement with human annotators against two prompting baselines.

datasets.name: WikiEval
datasets.source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/explodinggradients/WikiEval; pages on events since start of 2022, prioritising recent edits; questions and answers by ChatGPT from introductory section
datasets.preprocessing: Low-faithfulness answers: ChatGPT answer without context. Low answer relevance: ChatGPT told to answer incompletely. Low context relevance: back-link text added to context, or ChatGPT-completed context if no back-links.

other.use: embeds generated questions for cosine similarity
GPT Score and GPT Ranking baselines; WikiEval generation. Version not stated.

inference.samples: n generated questions per answer for answer relevance (n value not stated); other runs/seeds not stated
inference.prompting: zero-shot prompts listed in the paper; faithfulness statement-extraction prompt includes an undisclosed demonstration (footnote 3)

metrics.name: Faithfulness
metrics.definition: F=|V|/|S|: share of statements extracted from the answer that the LLM judges inferable from the context

metrics.name: Answer relevance
metrics.definition: AR=(1/n) sum cos(emb(q), emb(q_i)) over n questions the LLM generates from the answer

metrics.name: Context relevance
metrics.definition: CR = extracted crucial sentences / total sentences in context

metrics.name: Agreement with humans
metrics.definition: fraction of WikiEval pairs where the metric prefers the same answer/context as annotators

eval.protocol: Two human annotators, disagreements resolved by discussion; single run, no significance test stated

prompts.text:
Given a question and answer, create one or more statements from each sentence in the given answer.
question: [question]
answer: [answer]

Consider the given context and following statements, then determine whether they are supported by the information present in the context. Provide a brief explanation for each statement before arriving at the verdict (Yes/No). Provide a final verdict for each statement in order at the end in the given format. Do not deviate from the specified format.
statement: [statement 1]
...
statement: [statement n]

Generate a question for the given answer.
answer: [answer]

Please extract relevant sentences from the provided context that can potentially help answer the following question. If no relevant sentences are found, or if you believe the question cannot be answered from the given context, return the phrase "Insufficient Information". While extracting candidate sentences you're not allowed to make any changes to sentences from given context.

Faithfulness measures the information consistency of the answer against the given context. Any claims that are made in the answer that cannot be deduced from context should be penalized.
Given an answer and context, assign a score for faithfulness in the range 0-10.
context: [context]
answer: [answer]

Answer Relevancy measures the degree to which a response directly addresses and is appropriate for a given question. It penalizes the present of redundant information or incomplete answers given a question. Given an question and answer, rank each answer based on Answer Relevancy.
question: [question]
answer 1: [answer 1]
answer 2: [answer 2]

results.claim: Ragas faithfulness agrees with human pairwise preference 0.95 of the time, vs 0.72 GPT Score and 0.54 GPT Ranking.
results.setup: WikiEval (50 Wikipedia pages on post-2022 events), pairwise comparison of two answers or two contexts, agreement with human annotators; metrics computed with gpt-3.5-turbo-16k

results.claim: Ragas answer relevance agreement is 0.78 (GPT Score 0.52, GPT Ranking 0.40).
results.setup: WikiEval (50 Wikipedia pages on post-2022 events), pairwise comparison of two answers or two contexts, agreement with human annotators; metrics computed with gpt-3.5-turbo-16k
results.table: Table 1, row Ragas, column Ans. Rel.

results.claim: Ragas context relevance agreement is 0.70 (GPT Score 0.63, GPT Ranking 0.52); weakest dimension.
results.setup: WikiEval (50 Wikipedia pages on post-2022 events), pairwise comparison of two answers or two contexts, agreement with human annotators; metrics computed with gpt-3.5-turbo-16k
results.table: Table 1, row Ragas, column Cont. Rel.

results.claim: Annotators agreed on about 95% of cases for faithfulness and context relevance.
results.setup: Two annotators on WikiEval, before discussion
results.quote: For faithfulness and context relevance, the two annotators agreed in around 95% of cases.

results.claim: Annotators agreed on about 90% for answer relevance.
results.quote: For answer relevance, they agreed in around 90% of the cases.

results.claim: Context relevance was hardest: ChatGPT struggles to pick crucial sentences, especially from longer contexts.

limits: Only 50 questions from Wikipedia; pairwise task against deliberately degraded alternatives, not absolute scoring
Judge is a single closed model (gpt-3.5-turbo-16k); no variance, seeds or significance reported
Context relevance weak (0.70); ChatGPT struggles with long contexts
Answer relevance ignores factuality by design
Paper defines no context recall or context precision; later Ragas versions differ
